name: session_search
description: Search or read past conversations (FTS5, no LLM). Shape by args: `query` = discovery (top matching sessions, top one fully hydrated); `session_id` + `around_message_id` = scroll (window around an anchor); `session_id` alone = read that session; no args = browse recent sessions. Searches conversation history ONLY: when the user gave a direct source (URL, file, contact, live system) inspect that first; never conclude 'not found' from history alone. Use for 'what did we do about X', 'where did we leave Y'. Details: skill_view hermes-tools-guide

query.description: Discovery: keywords, phrases or boolean (OR, NOT, "phrase", prefix*). Omit to browse recent sessions; ignored when session_id is set.

sort.description: Discovery only. Omit for relevance; 'newest' (where did we leave X) / 'oldest' (how did X start) bias the ranking; not a time bound.

detail.description: Discovery only. 'adaptive' (default) hydrates only the top result; 'full' hydrates every result.

after.description: Discovery only. Inclusive lower bound on session start: ISO date or relative (7d, 24h, 2w). Only if the user names a time frame.

before.description: Discovery only. Exclusive upper bound: ISO date (date-only = midnight UTC) or relative (7d = older than a week). Only if the user names a time frame.

exclude_session_ids.description: Discovery only. Session ids already inspected, omitted from results. Cap 20.

session_id.description: Session from a discovery result. With around_message_id = scroll; alone = read the whole session.

around_message_id.description: Scroll. Message id to center on (match_message_id from discovery, or any id from a window).

window.description: Scroll only. Messages each side of the anchor, clamped to [1, 20]. Default 5.

role_filter.description: Comma-separated roles; discovery default 'user,assistant'; 'user,assistant,tool' adds tool output, 'tool' alone searches only it.
